environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in private subnet with NAT gateway. Service uses IAM role with s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::app-uploads-prod/*. WebSocket port 8080 exposed via NLB with no authentication layer. No session TTL configured. AWS credentials injected via task role (available in environment). S3 traffic routes through NAT gateway to public S3 endpoint.

config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, NLB forwarding TCP/8080
config.s3_endpoint: Public S3 endpoint via NAT gateway
